tiers.text: 4 of 68 registers have no recovered freeze condition
the flops form 57 register groups; the largest is reg_dfrtp_2_67 (12 members)
success is driven by one flop (dfrtp_2_66); its D cone has 9 leaves

Seven of the eight banks share one write enable and the eighth does not. Every extra term in that eighth enable is itself a register, so keep justifying backwards until each term is grounded in an input word or in a count of cycles -- and do not assume the address field names the register a command acts on.
